verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any way to issue scoped or least-privilege API credentials (tokens or keys with restricted permissions) for an agent. The MCP server lets Claude and ChatGPT connect to the inbox, and send actions require explicit approval, but per-send approval is a different control from scoped credentials. Org-wide admin control over connector permissions is likewise governance, not credential issuance, and no public API spec was found (OpenAPI probes returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
